name: Chicken Noodle Soup
description: Comforting soup with chicken, vegetables and egg noodles.
steps: Simmer the chicken breasts in the stock with the bay leaf for 20 minutes, then remove and shred.
Add the diced onion, carrot and celery to the stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the noodles and cook until tender.
Return the chicken, season and serve.
